description: Exact arithmetic over the turn's query results — sums, averages, rankings, pivots, differences, joins, percent change, filters — computed in-process by code, never by model-written code. Every figure it produces carries a receipt (operation · rows · statement) that the answer's numbers are traced back to.

tool_definition.name: TDA_Compute
tool_definition.description: Computes an exact figure over the rows a previous data query returned this turn (addressed by statement number; the latest by default). Use it instead of doing arithmetic yourself: the result is exact and carries a receipt. Operations: sum, avg, min, max, count, rank (top N by a column), pivot (aggregate by a group column), filter (rows matching one predicate), pct_change (first→last change of a column), join and diff (two statements on a shared column).[[gate:compute_sql]] Combine: op "sql" runs ONE read-only SELECT (DuckDB SQL) over this turn's results, each a table named s1, s2, … by its statement number — for joining or unioning results that came from DIFFERENT data sources, which no single query can reach.[[/gate]]

op.description: One of: sum | avg | min | max | count | rank | pivot | filter | pct_change | join | diff[[gate:compute_sql]] | sql[[/gate]]

column.description: The column to compute over. Optional when the result set has exactly one numeric column.

statement.description: Which data query's rows to use — its statement number in this turn (1 = the first query). Omit for the latest.

statement_b.description: The second statement for join / diff.

by.description: pivot: the column to group by.

agg.description: pivot: the aggregate per group — sum (default) | avg | min | max | count.

n.description: rank: how many rows to keep (default 10).

where.description: filter: ONE predicate as 'column op value', op in = != > < >= <= contains startswith (e.g. "miles > 1000").

on.description: join / diff: the shared key column.

order_by.description: pct_change: the column that orders the rows (e.g. the month) before measuring the change.

sql.description: [[gate:compute_sql]]op "sql": ONE SELECT in DuckDB SQL over the tables s1, s2, … (this turn's statement numbers; their columns are the result's columns). Read-only; no files, no network, no other tables. In a plan, name a phase's result p1, p2, … (its phase number).[[/gate]]
